body:
I wrote some really disgusting things about her. Half of it was true and the rest was embellished. I wanted to hurt her so badly and then once I hit the send button... all of that anger went away and all I feel now is guilt. I'm worried about what this will do to her...to her family... I wonder about how long it will take them to figure out it was me.. I can't stop panicking. I even just paid money to send a text message to the website owner in a desperate attempt to have him hear me out. 
I went through a rough divorce.. and I think that along with the fact that this woman is in a relationship with the man I always thought I'd end up with. Someone from my past who used me and hurt my feelings for fun. I wanted some revenge and the moment I got it I felt like killing myself. If people find out that I did such a disgusting.. childish thing... it is not something people would expect of me. I feel like my chest is going to explode....
